doc.headline: Keep {arm:September} as Kairo's persona model: both candidates cost {cost.uplift_range} more per reply and neither keeps character better, with {arm:qwen3.8-flash} clearly worse.

decision.text: Keep {arm:September} (the control). It is the cheapest arm at {cost_per_1k.September|usd_per_1k}, and neither candidate is ahead of it on character.

The weakest margin is {weakest.arm}'s: its corrected pass-rate interval reaches {weakest.value|pts} points against the {weakest.threshold|pts}-point line, {weakest.margin|pts} points inside it. This run contradicts the earlier finding that {arm:qwen3.8-flash} lowers production cost: here it costs {cost.uplift.qwen3.8-flash} more, at a provider routing the snapshot does not record.
